lines.2: 「So, yeah, one boy and one girl would be the perfect number of kids.」
lines.4: 「That's way too early to be getting worked up.」
lines.5: 「And before you start preaching about family life, find yourself a partner. You can't have kids by yourself.」
lines.7: 「Drop that vague 'I'm sure' nonsense. Try picturing it realistically.」
lines.10: 「What vision did you have of your future self?」
lines.11: 「Everyone around me got married, I panicked, and I ended up marrying some woman I didn't even love that much.」
lines.12: 「Then I worked myself to the bone to support her, and before I knew it, I wasn't young anymore...」
lines.13: 「That IS terrifying. Scarier than half the ghost stories out there.」
lines.14: 「Man, I hope I have a good romance someday.」
lines.16: 「Nope. I hate fresh-faced guys like you.」
lines.17: 「Ha ha ha! Quite a greeting. But I think this will be good for you too.」
lines.18: 「I want you to arrange things so I can be alone with Kanisawa.」
lines.19: 「Well, I'll be damned. You're after Crab?」
lines.21: 「Oh, yeah. I run a little business like that.」
lines.22: He handed me a business card.
lines.25: 「Subaru and Crab are popular. Girls kept asking me to introduce them, and it got annoying, so I figured I might as well turn it into a business.」
lines.27: 「Idiot. Do you have any idea how it feels to hear 'Introduce me to Date' over and over and over?」
lines.29: 「All right, valued customer. Which package would you like?」
lines.31: Sunset at Matsukasa Park: Fluttery Fun Course.
lines.34: 「Heh. I'll take the most expensive one--the Sunset at Matsukasa Park: Fluttery Fun Course.」
lines.35: 「Thank you kindly. That'll be five thousand yen.」
lines.36: He'd set the price just low enough that a student could actually pay it.
lines.37: 「So, what do you like about Crab? I mean, I know she's pretty, but...」
lines.39: 「She's always smiling and full of energy. Being around her makes me feel happier too.」
lines.41: That was when I realized he was serious.
lines.47: 「Relax. Crab's standards are sky-high, so she'll turn him down anyway.」
lines.51: 「Crab's pretty popular, you know. Her face is nice, at least.」
lines.52: 「She's an upper-tier idiot, even among idiots... Who would've guessed?」
lines.53: 「...Let me see the brochure for Subaru.」
lines.54: 「What?! You're gonna book the Subaru package?!」

lines.58: Post-Rejection Aftercare with Shinichi Samehyo. (Thorough care guaranteed.)
lines.59: Play Lovers with Shinichi Samehyo Standing In for Subaru Date. (I fully commit to the role.)
lines.61: 「For some reason, nobody's ever booked a Subaru package.」
lines.63: 「Charging money for this is shameless even by your standards.」
lines.65: 「So, I set the two of you up... How'd it go?」
lines.66: 「Hmm. I turned him down. He wasn't my type.」
lines.68: 「Don't make me sound cruel. Turning someone down properly is its own kind of kindness, right?」
lines.72: ...That was a lot. I hadn't known.
lines.73: 「I wish somebody would confess to me.」
lines.75: 「No guarantee you'll be reborn human, though.」
lines.76: 「No, seriously. I just want one confession before I die.」
lines.77: 「You never give up, even when they're insulting you, do you?」
lines.82: 「Guess I'll head home too and escape reality with a dating sim.」
lines.85: 「Your standards are too high. Guys like that don't exactly grow on trees.」
lines.86: Crab flopped down on the bed.
lines.87: ...She always started sleeping the second those two left.
lines.89: 「Shut up. Having me in your room makes it bloom like a flower. You oughta thank me.」
lines.90: 「And once you're grateful, remember that July twentieth is the sacred festival of my birth, okay?」
lines.91: Oh, right. It was almost that time of year.
lines.92: 「Back to what I was saying. The Princess is gorgeous, rich, smart, and insanely athletic, right?」
lines.94: 「If a woman like that exists, there has to be a man like that too! Damn it!」
lines.97: 「You're such a chicken, Leo. A beauty like that is right there, but all you do is admire her from afar. You never make a move.」
lines.98: 「Then again, that IS just like you.」
lines.99: 「Don't you call me chicken, damn it!」
lines.100: I jumped onto the bed and caught her in a joint lock.
lines.101: 「When somebody's that beautiful, it just makes me feel like we're from different worlds. I hate that.」
lines.103: 「You two are making far too much noise up here.」
lines.104: 「Honestly. You're like a brother and sister who get along too well.」
lines.105: 「Then does that make you my big sister, Otome?」
lines.107: 「I have always thought of you as a little sister. If anything troubles you, come tell me.」
lines.108: 「In that case, Leo's picking on me!」
lines.111: 「All right! We'll attack from both sides!」
lines.113: Otome climbed on top of me and pinned my hands down.
lines.114: 「Resistance is futile for a weakling like you.」
lines.116: Where did this woman get all that strength?
lines.120: 「Ow, ow, ow! That hurts, but it feels good!」
lines.127: The two of them bullied me to their hearts' content, then left.
lines.128: I had no need for such violent sisters.
lines.129: Damn that Crab. She got so cocky whenever Otome was around.
lines.130: Next time, I'd make her cry again.
